lesson: A required_tests entry must name a REAL leaf test (id = the string in test("...")), not the file path, and must pin TS_NODE_PROJECT=backend/tsconfig.json because forge runs it from repo root; otherwise junit-run's --test-name-pattern matches nothing and ts-node skips the workspace tsconfig, so the gate reports pass without running assertions. Always verify with a negative control (a required test whose negative control cannot fail is not proof).
